$comment: Copy per interrupted cohort as eval/cohorts/<build>.resume.contract.json (generalizes 906990f.resume.contract.json). Fill before any resumed rater starts, then never change it. mode: 'continue' = the same rater identity continues its own checkpoint (its notes and partial card are its own, same card); 'fresh-blind' = a new blind rater starts from the checkpointed save only, with no notes or partial card, on a new card (906990f's choice).
status: <why the cohort was interrupted; what is preserved>
manifestSha256: <served asset manifest sha256; must match the original cohort>

budget.$comment: The resumed session's caps are the original caps minus what the checkpoint records as used; a rater dying twice does not reset its budget.

blindness: continue: same rater continues from its own checkpoint (notes, partial card), no coordinator context. fresh-blind: fresh agent, fork_turns none, brief + save only; no interrupted rater notes, desired score, source or design history.
releaseConditions: served manifest matches the original cohort
checkpoint save restores exactly (tools/rater-checkpoint.mjs restore prints no WARNING)

decisionCriteria.$comment: Copy the original cohort contract's decision criteria unchanged; a resume never relaxes them.
